headline: FOUR TEAMS LOST GAMES THEIR OWN BENCH WOULD HAVE WON. ONE PAID $6 FOR A 0.00 🪑💸

sections.heading: THE BENCH WON FOUR GAMES THIS WEEK. NONE OF THEM COUNTED 🪑🏆
sections.body:
Three managers lost this week to a lineup they already owned. Not a free agent, not a trade target. A guy sitting on their own bench. LOL. (A fourth, imbackbeech, gets its own section below.) 🤦

jayvang100 lost to Evz132 by 3.98 and benched Brock Purdy, who scored 29.28, to start Dak Prescott (23.50). That swap alone wins the game by 1.80. muahuavang lost to VangMushu by 9.25 and benched Bryce Young (26.34) for Caleb Williams (16.76). That's a 9.58 swing, a win by 0.33, and the most painful third of a point of the season. 😭

KevinVang lost to cvang1990 by 5.43 while Rome Odunze put up 14.00 on the bench. Start him over Stefon Diggs (6.60) and KevinVang wins by 1.97. Three games, three benches, three group-chat screenshots that will never be deleted. 📸

sections.heading: THE $6 ZERO 💸🫥
sections.body:
imbackbeech spent $6 of FAAB on Adonai Mitchell, dropped the Houston Texans defense to make room, and started him at flex. Mitchell scored 0.00. Tyler Goodson did 7.70 on the bench. imbackbeech lost to Tub89 by 6.41. You can do the math, but you won't enjoy it. 🧮

It gets worse. KevinVang scooped up those same Texans for a $0 bid, and they scored 19.05, the best defense in the league this week. So imbackbeech paid six bucks to lose a game AND hand a rival the week's top D. That is a two-for-one deal, just not for imbackbeech. LOL. 🎁

The other shame: imbackbeech's actual players showed up. Ja'Marr Chase 26.50, Christian Watson 26.60, Javonte Williams 20.40. Jared Goff scored 5.30, though, so maybe not everybody. 🫠

sections.heading: C.J. STROUD 45.36, AND TUB89 BARELY SURVIVED IT 😅
sections.body:
C.J. Stroud put up 45.36, the best individual score in the league, and CeeDee Lamb added 28.50. That's 73.86 from two players. Tub89 won by... 6.41. 🫨

How? D'Andre Swift scored 3.10, Quinshon Judkins 5.00, Dalton Kincaid 4.30, and the Bengals defense 2.30. Plus Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked 17.00 on the bench while Tyler Bass kicked 13.00 in the lineup. Tub89 is 6-3 and somehow made a 45-point quarterback feel like a coin flip. 🪙

sections.heading: THE BLOWOUT: YMVTHEDAD 134.89, TONGLUE 86.93 💥
sections.body:
The week's high score and the week's biggest margin, 47.96, came from the same game. Joe Burrow had another monster day (35.54), Luther Burden III added 17.20, and the Chiefs defense chipped in 14.55. 🔥

Burden is brand new, by the way. YMVtheDAD traded Jonah Coleman to ChunckyM for him, and both sides won this week: Burden 17.20 for YMVtheDAD, Coleman 16.80 for ChunckyM. A fair trade in this league? Somebody check on the commish. 🤝

Tonglue's best player was the kicker. Spencer Shrader's 16.00 nearly matched James Cook III (16.70), Tucker Kraft scored 1.40, and Tonglue's free-agent pickup Darius Cooper went straight into the lineup for 3.50. Rough. 🥶

sections.heading: THE NAIL-BITER: THE BOOKIE WINS AGAIN 🎰
sections.body:
Evz132, the league's official bookie, beat jayvang100 108.23 to 104.25. Jordan Love carried the whole thing with 42.18, which was 39% of the team's points. Jonathan Taylor scored 6.90 and DJ Moore 5.10, so Love really did have to do it alone. 💪

The house always wins. Especially when the other side benches a 29-point quarterback. 🏦

sections.heading: THE STANDINGS: CHUNCKYM AND HVANG94 PULL AWAY 🏎️
sections.body:
ChunckyM (7-2, 1040.77 points for) and Hvang94 (7-2, 987.78) both won comfortably. Hvang94 bounced back from last week's loss behind Kenneth Walker III (34.30), so the team called Not good, Just lucky is lucky again. 🍀

YMVtheDAD and Tub89 sit right behind them at 6-3. Then comes a four-way traffic jam at 5-4: cvang1990, mouavang86, KevinVang and Evz132. 🚗🚗🚗🚗

At the bottom, VangMushu finally won, beating muahuavang 89.21 to 79.96. Now both teams are 2-7 and VangMushu isn't alone in the basement anymore. Misery loves company. 🏚️

sections.heading: WAIVER WATCH: DEFENSE MUSICAL CHAIRS 🎶
sections.body:
The waiver wire this week was mostly defenses changing hands. The Texans went from imbackbeech to KevinVang and scored 19.05. KevinVang's old Packers went to cvang1990 for $2 and scored 10.30, which was more than the Browns defense cvang1990 actually started (9.20). Because of course it was. 🙃

In the QB room, cvang1990 picked up Malik Willis and started him for 3.82. Lamar Jackson sat on the bench at 0.00. That QB slot is officially haunted. 👻

sections.heading: THE FULL FOURTEEN: EVERYBODY GETS A TURN 🎤
sections.body:
1. YMVtheDAD — 134.89, won by 47.96. Joe Burrow (35.54) and new arrival Luther Burden III (17.20) put up the week's high score and its biggest blowout. Omar Cooper Jr. went back to the bench and scored 9.80 there, so for once, benching him was the right call. 🧿

2. Tub89 — 120.36, won by 6.41. C.J. Stroud's 45.36 was the best individual score in the league, and CeeDee Lamb added 28.50. Then Swift (3.10), Kincaid (4.30) and the Bengals D (2.30) almost gave it all back, while Fairbairn kicked 17.00 on the bench. 😬

3. Hvang94 — 118.76, won by 30.63. Kenneth Walker III ran for 34.30 and Jake Bates kicked 15.00. Jadarian Price (9.80) and Dallas Goedert (7.50) beat their starters from the bench, but luck doesn't need an optimal lineup. 🍀

4. imbackbeech — 113.95, LOST by 6.41. The 4th-best score in the league and a loss anyway, because the $6 pickup Adonai Mitchell scored 0.00 at flex while Tyler Goodson did 7.70 on the bench. Chase (26.50) and Watson (26.60) deserved a better manager this week. LOL. 💸

5. ChunckyM — 111.96, won by 32.40. Matthew Golden went off for 27.40, Brock Bowers added 18.80, and trade pickup Jonah Coleman scored 16.80 in his debut. Josh Allen scored 14.86 and Parker Washington did 13.10 on the bench, but 7-2 and first on points makes it hard to complain. 👑

6. Evz132 — 108.23, won by 3.98. Jordan Love's 42.18 carried a lineup where Jonathan Taylor (6.90) and DJ Moore (5.10) did almost nothing. Tyler Shough scored 21.70 on the bench, but starting Love was the right call by 20 points. 🎰

7. jayvang100 — 104.25, LOST by 3.98. Bijan Robinson scored 23.70 and Dak Prescott 23.50. Brock Purdy scored 29.28 on the bench, and that swap wins the game by 1.80. Ouch. 🪑

8. cvang1990 — 99.42, won by 5.43. Tee Higgins (17.70) and Cam Little (17.00) carried a team whose QB, Malik Willis, scored 3.82. KC Concepcion Jr. did 16.80 on the bench while Rachaad White scored 5.90 at flex, so winning was a gift from KevinVang's bench. 🎁

9. KevinVang — 93.99, LOST by 5.43. The $0 Texans pickup was a genius move, scoring 19.05 as the week's best defense, and Christian McCaffrey added 21.70. But Rome Odunze scored 14.00 on the bench while Stefon Diggs did 6.60 in the lineup, and that swap wins it. 🤦

10. VangMushu — 89.21, won by 9.25. Bucky Irving went off for 26.50 and VangMushu finally has a second win. Tyler Loop kicked a perfect 0.00, but who cares, it's a W. 🥳

11. mouavang86 — 88.13, LOST by 30.63. Puka Nacua did his job with 28.00, Josh Jacobs scored 0.50, and the Cardinals' Chad Ryland kicked 3.00. Mahomes (20.48) over the benched Bo Nix (19.68) was the right call by 0.80, so at least the quarterback drama is over. 🎭

12. Tonglue — 86.93, LOST by 47.96. On the wrong end of the week's biggest blowout. Spencer Shrader kicked 16.00, almost as much as James Cook III's 16.70, while Tucker Kraft scored 1.40. When your kicker is your second-best player, it's going to be a long Sunday. 🦵

13. muahuavang — 79.96, LOST by 9.25. Bryce Young scored 26.34 on the bench while Caleb Williams scored 16.76 as the starter. That's a 9.58 swing in a 9.25 loss, and the Patriots defense at -1.00 didn't help. 😭

14. Keeneng — 79.56, LOST by 32.40. The week's lowest score, and Justice Hill did 16.70 on the bench while Derrick Henry scored 5.58 in the lineup. Juwan Johnson (10.40) also sat behind Kyle Pitts Sr. (3.80). Even the perfect lineup only gets to 99.06, so the roster has problems too. 🪦
